args: data=${RECOLLECT_PLUGIN_DATA:-}; if [ -z "$data" ]; then case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) data="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Recollect/plugin";; *) data="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/recollect/plugin";; esac; fi; [ -f "$data/runtime-path" ] && [ ! -L "$data/runtime-path" ] || exit 1; IFS= read -r runtime < "$data/runtime-path"; case "$runtime" in /*) ;; *) exit 1;; esac; [ -f "$runtime" ] && [ -x "$runtime" ] && [ ! -L "$runtime" ] || exit 1; exec "$runtime" mcp
